items.title: Paul Barnes Interview, 1971-03-13
items.q: Yeah, they had Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, and Buddy P.T. But none of them could surpass Kid Rene.

ctx.x: Yeah, they had Sam Morgan, Chris Kelly, and Buddy P.T. But none of them could surpass Kid Rene. That's fabulous.
Yeah, yeah. Do you say you worked with Chris Kelly's band? I was not a regular member of his band, but I worked with his band. Do you remember when Emil worked in his band?
Yeah. He was with him a long time, huh?
